description:
Turn your ideas, Slack chats, and AI conversations into stunning presentations with Gamma 5: https://gam.link/VARUNMAYYA

In this video, I’m looking at where AI, technology, and the job market could be headed over the next few years, based on what I’m already seeing through our work with hundreds of companies and the wider tech industry.

I also revisit some of the predictions I made back in 2024 for 2025 to see how they played out, what I got right, and where I got things wrong.

The goal here is to look beyond all the hype and focus on the changes that are already happening around us. A lot of the things that seem distant today are already being tested by businesses, and understanding these shifts early could help you make better decisions about your career, the skills you develop, and the opportunities you pursue.

These are my personal takes based on what I’m seeing right now, and you might disagree with some of them. But I think it’s worth having these conversations before these
